TWO GAME MODES
- Classic
- Round-The-Clock

CLASSIC RULES
- Play 1-10 players.
- Play 5, 10 or 20 rounds.
- Mark up distances 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 meters from the basket.
- Pick 5 preferably similar putters.
- You always throw all 5 discs from the same distance and you always start at 10 meters.
- Depending on how many successful throws you manage to make, the app will tell you which distance to throw from next time its your turn as well as counting your score.
- If you miss all throws you go to 5 meters next time.
- If you make 1 successful throw you go to 6 meters.
- If you make 2 successful throws you go to 7 meters
- And so forth...
- Points are given for every successful throw matching the number of meters you throw from.
- Every successful 5 meter throw gives 5 points.
- Every successful 6 meter throw gives 6 points.
- And so forth...
- Once all rounds (5, 10 or 20) have been played the player with most points will be the winner.

ROUND-THE-CLOCK RULES
- Play 1-6 players
- Mark up distances 5, 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10 meters in a circle around the basket.
- Each player picks 5 preferably similar putters.
- All players go to their individual start distance. First player 5m, second 6m etc.
- All players tries to make a many putts as possible with their own 5 discs.
- 2 points are given for every successful throw and 1 point for every metal throw - NO matter the distance.
- Collect all discs and rotate clock-wise to new distances as indicated in the app.
- Repeat for 6 rounds.
- Once all rounds (always 6) have been played the player with most points will be the winner.
